audit_item: No physical host-microbe interaction is claimed.
Ochrobactrum is described only in associative/co-occurrence terms.
The basal-classical spatial-axis association is not overstated.
Moncada remains exploratory only, with positive concordance in only 1 of 6 sections.
CTCFL/BORIS remains excluded from prioritisation because of CELL_COMPOSITION_EXPLAINED.
CTCFL/BORIS is not rescued by literature-based or post hoc biological plausibility.
HALLMARK_SPERMATOGENESIS remains a null/failed validation finding.
MEred and MEpurple remain failed or unsupported findings.
The 9 failed TF activities remain explicit.
No candidate is described as an established therapeutic target.
All null, partial, exploratory, and limitation statements remain visible in Abstract, Results, Discussion, Limitations, figure legends, and supplementary table legends.
Evidence categories and target rankings are unchanged from the accepted Phase 10C2 / Phase 11C framework.
